يبتلون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَلُونَ (yabtalūna) /jab.ta.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# يُبْتَلَوْنَ (yubtalawna) /jub.ta.law.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
